ui.tripIntro: Follows your location live, shows the way to your next stop, and estimates distance and steps. When you reach a place it offers to mark it visited. Your location stays on this phone; it works while the app is open.
ui.tripDone: You visited every stop in your plan!
ui.noGeo: Location is not available on this phone. Allow location access.
ui.metroBtn: I am on the metro / tram
ui.metroNote: GPS does not work underground; the estimate assumes ~2 minutes per stop. Station lists are to be verified.
ui.metroExit: Location is back; metro estimate turned off.
ui.noVisits: You haven't marked any place yet. After a visit, tap "I visited" on its card to earn points and badges. Visited places turn green on the map.
ui.memNote: Your memories are stored only on this phone.
ui.sosText: Police, ambulance, fire: one number for all.
ui.phraseHint: Listen reads the phrase aloud in Turkish. Show puts it on screen in big letters so you can show it to someone.
ui.noVoice: No Turkish voice on this phone; use Show instead.
ui.micHint: Tap the microphone and speak; the text fills in. Your voice goes to the phone's speech service (Google or Apple).
ui.micDenied: No microphone permission. Allow the microphone in your browser settings.
ui.micNoSpeech: No speech heard. Tap the microphone and try again.
ui.micFail: Speech recognition did not work (it needs internet). You can type instead.
ui.railTitle: Metro, tram, Marmaray: which line, which direction?
ui.railIntro: Type where you start and where you are going. We show which line to take, which sign to look for on the platform and after how many stops to get off.
ui.railPh: Type a station or a place…
ui.railPick: Pick a station or place from the list (it opens as you type).
ui.railSame: Both are near the same station; you can walk.
ui.railNone: No rail connection found. You may need a bus, ferry or taxi.
ui.railNoPos: Could not get your location. Allow location or type a station.
ui.railWalkTo: 🚶 Walk from {from} to {to} station (about {m} m, {min} min)
ui.railWalkFrom: 🚶 Leave {from} station and walk to {to} (about {m} m, {min} min)
ui.railFar: Far: a taxi or bus may be better.
ui.railChange: ↔ Change: get off at {a} and walk to the {line} line ({b}, about {m} m). Follow the {line} signs.
ui.railSignLabel: Look for this sign on the platform
ui.railLoop: This line runs one way in a loop; every tram goes the right way.
ui.railRide: Board at {from} → {n} stops → get off at {to}.
ui.railNotNow: There may be no service now (outside operating hours).
ui.railComputed: This line's stop order was worked out from station positions; check the official map too.
ui.railTip: Tip: the destination shown on the front of the train must be beyond your stop. Some trains end early. Times are estimates.
ui.railSource: Source: Metro İstanbul and İBB Open Data ({d}). Line colors from Metro İstanbul; Marmaray, M11, F2 and Sirkeci–Kazlıçeşme colors are not official.
ui.phraseNone: No phrase with that word. Try another word.
ui.asstNoBackendShort: Ask questions, translate. Needs internet and the server; not ready yet.
ui.asstReadyShort: Ask about your trip, translate any language to and from Turkish.
ui.asstNoBackend: This part is not ready yet. The assistant and translator need internet and the app's own server, which is not set up yet. The pocket phrasebook works offline in the meantime.
ui.asstOffline: No internet. The assistant and translator need internet. The pocket phrasebook works offline.
ui.asstHello: Hello! Ask me about your Istanbul trip: where to go, how to get there, what it costs, which day a place is closed. I answer from the app's own information and say so when I am not sure.
ui.asstSug2: What is the cheapest way to Sultanahmet?
ui.asstSug3: Where should I have lunch on my plan?
ui.asstShareNote: Unless you tick these, your plan and location are not sent. Location is rounded to about 100 metres.
ui.asstPrivacy: What you type is sent to the app's server and an AI service to get an answer. Do not type personal details such as your name or passport number. AI can be wrong; check prices and hours with the official source.
ui.asstWait: Please wait a moment, then send again.
ui.asstError: Could not get an answer. Check your internet and try again.
ui.asstLimit: Too many in a row. Wait a minute and try again.
ui.asstBusy: The assistant is very busy right now. Try again shortly.
ui.trMatches: Offline: similar phrases in the pocket phrasebook
ui.trNoMatch: No similar phrase in the pocket phrasebook.
ui.trEmpty: Type the text to translate first.
ui.routeToPlan: Add this route to my plan
ui.planEmpty: Add a ready route, or pick places with + in "Explore places". The app works out times, walking and transport.
ui.closedWarn: This place is closed on {d}. Move it to another day or remove it.
ui.planNote: Times are estimates: walking 4.5 km/h, city traffic ~18 km/h. Closing days and hours are on each place card.
ui.allPlacesIntro: Tap a (!) marker on the map to see that place here. Pick a route and it is drawn on the map.
ui.locateFail: Could not get your location. Allow location access in your phone settings.
ui.taxiHow: Start {s} TL + {k} TL per km + {w} TL per hour waiting, minimum {m} TL
ui.carHow: Fuel only, assuming {l} L per 100 km. Parking, bridge and motorway tolls not included.
ui.transitHow: One full-fare ride with an Istanbulkart. Students {st} TL. Without a card: single-use ticket {single} TL, or an Istanbulkart for {card} TL (card price). Ferry Karaköy/Eminönü–Kadıköy {ferry} TL. Transfers cost less. Source: metro.istanbul, sehirhatlari.istanbul ({d}).
ui.fareSrc: Taxi fare source: IMM UKOME (checked {d}). Distance is estimated from the straight line and varies with traffic and route.
ui.todayIs: Today is {d}. Markets open today are highlighted.
ui.noMarkets: No market info for this district yet.
ui.mapWasBroken: The saved map was incomplete and has been removed. You can download it again below.
ui.mapDownloadFail: The download stopped. Check your connection and try again.
ui.mapSaved: The Istanbul map is saved on this phone. It works offline.
ui.mapOnline: The map is loading over the internet. Download it once to use it offline (Wi-Fi recommended).
ui.mapNeedDownload: No internet and the map is not downloaded. Download it when you are back online.
ui.packageNote: Payment opens soon. During the beta all features are free for now.
ui.installIos: On iPhone: tap Share in Safari, then "Add to Home Screen".
ui.installOther: Choose "Add to Home screen" or "Install app" from the browser menu.
ui.reportLabel: What is missing or wrong? (e.g. "This market is on Thursdays")
ui.reportSaved: Saved. Reports waiting on this phone: {n}. They will be sent once the server is connected.
ui.reportCopied: Copied. You can send it by WhatsApp or email.
ui.about: Info checked on {d}. Map data: © OpenStreetMap contributors, Protomaps.
ui.loadError: Could not load the city info. Check your connection and reload.

content: The main floor is a mosque and free for worship; tourist visits go through the upper gallery (entrance by the ramp under the minaret). The nearby Hagia Sophia History and Experience Museum is open daily 09:00–20:00.
Gallery, Turkish citizens: €25 in 2024; 2026 price to be verified
Closed to visitors during prayer times. Cover shoulders and knees.

Underground Byzantine reservoir with the Medusa heads. In June 2026 management passed from the city to the General Directorate of Foundations (legal dispute ongoing). Winter hours (15 Nov–31 Mar): 09:00–18:00.
Current price to be verified (the new operator has not published a tariff)
Just below Topkapı, by the Gülhane Park entrance. Daily 09:00–18:30, ticket office closes 17:30.
Turkish citizens: with the Museum Card (300 TL a year from 1 Dec 2026)

CLOSED ON TUESDAYS. 09:00–17:30, ticket office closes 17:00. The combined ticket covers the palace, the Harem and Hagia Irene, valid for 1 day. The Museum Card is not valid for the Harem and Hagia Irene.
Closed on Sundays. Bargaining is normal.
Sunset view over the Golden Horn from the courtyard.
Ferries to Kadıköy, Üsküdar and the Bosphorus leave from here.
Ferry to Kadıköy: 65.21 TL (Istanbulkart, full fare)
Tea by the water, coffee in the side streets.
360° view from the top. Day 08:30–18:30, night museum 18:30–22:00. The queue can be long.
Free by day with the Museum Card
Metro and bus connections are here.
Opera, ballet, concerts and theatre. Programme and ticket prices will be added from the official site.
CLOSED ON MONDAYS. Ticket office 09:00–17:00. 19th-century palace on the Bosphorus. The ticket covers the Selamlık, Harem and Painting Museum. The Museum Card is not valid for the Selamlık.
Ferry link to the European side.
Picnic on the grass and sunset. Busy at weekends.
Daily 09:00–18:00, ticket office 17:00. Boats leave from Salacak (09:30–17:00) and Karaköy (09:30, 11:00, 12:30, 14:00, 15:30, 17:00); weather permitting.
Museum Card accepted (per news); boat fare extra, to be verified
Tulip festival in April. Picnic spots and breakfast pavilions.
Run by the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry (DKMP). Car entry is paid by HGS toll tag. Open-fire picnics may be restricted; ask about barbecues at the gate.
Whether walkers are actually charged is to be verified
Car-free island. Reached by ferry, explored by bike or electric shuttle.
Byzantine and Ottoman Istanbul in one day, on foot.
From Karaköy to Taksim: cafés, the tower, İstiklal and an evening show.
Cross by ferry, eat in the market, sunset in Moda.
A palace on the Bosphorus, breakfast in the park, a forest walk. By car or taxi.
Police, ambulance, fire, gendarmerie and coast guard: all on 112. The call is free.
Yerebatan St. No:6, Sultanahmet. This number is not confirmed by an official source; in an emergency call 112.
For the Istanbulkart, transport and city services.
Report it to the police first (112), then go to your country's consulate in Istanbul. Keep a photo of your passport on your phone.
20 GB data, 200 minutes, 100 SMS, unlimited WhatsApp, 28 days. Suggested price 1,800 TL. With your passport, in a Turkcell shop or as an eSIM in their app.
20 GB, 750 minutes, unlimited WhatsApp, 28 days. The official page shows no price. At airport shops or as an eSIM.
10 GB 320 TL (7 days) · 25 GB 420 TL (28 days) · 50 GB 550 TL (28 days). At airport dealers and shops.
Your own SIM (roaming) works fine. With a Turkish SIM an unregistered phone works for 120 days; staying longer needs IMEI registration (2026 fee 54,258 TL per news reports).
Download the Istanbul map on Wi-Fi (50 MB). It then works offline.
The currency is the Turkish lira (TL). If an ATM offers "currency conversion", decline it and withdraw in TL; it is usually cheaper. Exchange offices in town usually beat airport rates.
Works on metro, tram, bus, ferry and Marmaray. The card costs 165 TL, a ride 46.20 TL. Without a card, a single-use ticket is 65 TL.
From the ticket machines at metro, tram and ferry stations. You top it up at the same machines.
Make sure the meter is on when you get in. Estimate the fare in the Transport tab.
The Karaköy/Eminönü–Kadıköy ferry is 65.21 TL: the cheapest Bosphorus view.
The city's free Wi-Fi in squares, piers and parks. On a smartphone you connect through the "İstanbul Senin" app.
Cover shoulders and knees; women cover their hair (scarves are given at the door). Take your shoes off. Tourist entry closes briefly at prayer times.
Bargaining is normal in the Grand Bazaar and markets; shop and restaurant prices are fixed.
In restaurants about 5–10% is common if you liked the service; it is not required.
Topkapı is closed on Tuesdays, Dolmabahçe on Mondays, the Grand Bazaar on Sundays. The My plan tab warns you automatically.
